offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results; paid-plan pay-as-you-go increments cost $5 (Hobby: 1,000 credits; Standard: 2,000; Growth: 2,500; Scale: 5,000).
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions 和 URLs，可选返回每个结果的 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots
offerings.note: 搜索结果默认包含 query-relevant Highlights；1–10 results = 2 credits，启用抓取另按每页收费。
